messages:
Jordan Park: Hey all — quick onboarding snag. I can sign into Okta and 1Password fine, but when I try to open the team Drive folder 'prod-models' I get 'You need access' (Error 403). @Priya any chance group mapping hasn't hit my account yet? :wave:
Priya Patel: Hi Jordan! Welcome :) Can you check your Google account email in the top-right of Drive? It should be your @redwood.com address. Also, what's the exact folder URL?
Jordan Park: confirmed it's my @redwood.com email. Folder URL: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdEFgHijkLmnop Q: could this be a group membership delay? I joined via the onboarding flow earlier.
it-provisioning-bot: Automated provisioning: Okta user created for jordan.park@redwood.com at 2026-03-23T09:12:04Z. Google Workspace account provisioned at 2026-03-23T09:13:02Z. Password manager link delivered.
Samir Rao: @Priya fyi new-hires flow marks them as 'engineering-new' group. prod-models folder is shared to 'eng-prod' group, not 'engineering-new'. Jordan, that mismatch would explain it.
Priya Patel: Thanks Samir — looks like the new-hires-to-eng mapping didn't run for a small subset. I can add Jordan to eng-prod manually; will do in a sec.
Alex M: If you see the 403 persist after Priya adds you, try clearing cookies or open an incognito window. Drive occasionally caches permissions for a few minutes.
Jordan Park: Thanks — appreciate it. If Priya adds me, do I need to raise a ticket or will the change be immediate?
Priya Patel: Should be immediate for folder access, but if it doesn't show up in 5-10m ping me and I'll escalate. Also filing a quick fix ticket so the sync mapping is corrected for future hires.
Samir Rao: Filing note for ops: "Sync job 'onboard-group-mapper' skipped eng-prod mapping on 2026-03-23T08:59:00Z due to transient API error. Manual patch applied for jordan.park@redwood.com; scheduled retry for remaining users."
Jordan Park: Just tried incognito — can open folder now! :tada: Thanks everyone. One last thing — do I need to set up a separate SSH key for GitHub or will SSO provision it?
Alex M: GitHub access is separate. You'll get an invite to the org. For SSH, yes you should generate a key locally and add it to GitHub: 
```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "jordan.park@redwood.com"
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
```
Priya Patel: Also, if you hit any MFA prompts oddities in Okta (we had a small delay with passkey registration earlier) — try re-registering under Profile -> Extra Verification Methods. Ping me if you want me to walk through it.
Jordan Park: Will do. Thanks again — super smooth otherwise. :blob-heart:
